svg.aria-label: Barbell overhead press, Rack: Hold the bar at your upper chest and brace your stomach and glutes.
svg.title: Barbell overhead press, Rack: Hold the bar at your upper chest and brace your stomach and glutes.

svg.aria-label: Barbell overhead press, Face level: Move your head slightly back and press the bar past your face.
svg.title: Barbell overhead press, Face level: Move your head slightly back and press the bar past your face.

svg.aria-label: Barbell overhead press, Clear head: Once the bar clears your head, press it back into line over your shoulders.
svg.title: Barbell overhead press, Clear head: Once the bar clears your head, press it back into line over your shoulders.

svg.aria-label: Barbell overhead press, Overhead: Finish with arms long overhead and ribs stacked over your hips.
svg.title: Barbell overhead press, Overhead: Finish with arms long overhead and ribs stacked over your hips.

svg.aria-label: Barbell overhead press, Lower: Lower the bar under control, keeping it clear of your head.
svg.title: Barbell overhead press, Lower: Lower the bar under control, keeping it clear of your head.

svg.aria-label: Barbell overhead press, Return: Bring the bar past your face and back to your upper chest.
svg.title: Barbell overhead press, Return: Bring the bar past your face and back to your upper chest.
